calls.title: Lenscratch Fatherhood Exhibition
calls.description: Online exhibition exploring fatherhood as an evolving role shaped by culture, responsibility, tenderness, and family expectations. Submit one image via Google Form (72dpi, 1000px long side).

calls.title: Lenscratch Fault Lines: America Exhibition
calls.description: Online exhibition examining tensions, fractures, and transformations across America — resistance, social change, protest, activism, justice, identity, power, and freedom. Submit one image via Google Form (72dpi, 1000px long side). Timed for July 4th.

calls.title: SE Center for Photography — Magic of Light
calls.description: Virtual juried exhibition exploring light and shadow as the foundation of photography. Submit up to 15 images. Juror: Wendi Schneider. 35–40 images selected for virtual gallery. 0% commission on sales. All photographers regardless of location, age, or skill level. Analog and digital welcome.

calls.title: photoED Magazine — Home VS Away (Issue #76)
calls.description: Fine art photography projects investigating the idea of home, the experience of being away, or the tension between the two. 10 selected projects published in print edition, 25 more in digital companion. Contributors receive printed copies with worldwide shipping. Free for subscribers and economically challenged artists.

calls.title: photoED Magazine — Real VS Imagined
calls.description: Fine art photography projects engaging with what is real versus what is imagined. 10 selected projects published in print edition, 25 more in digital companion. Contributors receive printed copies with worldwide shipping. Free for subscribers.

calls.title: LUMA Rencontres Dummy Book Award 2026
calls.description: Annual award supporting publication of an unpublished photobook dummy. Special attention to experimental and innovative editorial forms. Winner's dummy and shortlisted entries exhibited at Les Rencontres d'Arles 2026. €25,000 production budget for the winning book.

calls.title: 8th Chelsea International Photography Competition
calls.description: International photography competition with exhibition at Agora Gallery in Chelsea, New York. 30 photographers selected for collective exhibition. Open to all genres and camera types. Five winners receive $500 cash each plus exhibition and online promotion.

calls.title: Creatura Magazine Issue 02 — What We Call Home
calls.description: Open call for Issue 02 of this indie print magazine exploring the idea of home — not only as a physical space but as an emotional territory. Selected photographs featured in a collective section of the print edition.

calls.title: F-Stop Magazine Issue #137 — Open Theme
calls.description: No theme — all fine art and documentary photography welcome. Submit up to 12 photographs. One submission per person per issue. Featured artist selected from submissions. Published since 2004.

calls.title: Photo Trouvée Virtual Artist Residency — Spring 2026
calls.description: 10-week virtual residency (April 24 – June 26, 2026) for artists who work with or are inspired by found/family photographs. Weekly Zoom calls, bio/statement workshops, artist talks, group feedback, accountability groups. Only 9 artists selected. Partial scholarships available.
